{{Lang|Hao'bai|zh=浩白|zh_rm=Hàobái}} is an NPC in {{Location|Memento Square}}.

==Location==
Hao'bai can be found in Memento Square after completing the quest [[Utterance of Marvels: II]].

<gallery>
NPC Location Hao'bai.png|Hao'bai's location
NPC Location Hao'bai Context.png|Additional context
</gallery>

==Profile==
Hao'bai is one of the engineers helping [[Yirou]] in the restoration of [[Memento Square]]. He has a more practical perspective on the restoration, believing that issues like border defense should be addressed before other, more culturally important projects like the restoration of [[Jué|Jué's]] statue. Hao'bai's feelings for Yirou are known by other members of the project,<ref>Dialogue with [[Xianfeng]]</ref> though he denies them.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Hao'bai}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} Need any help?
:'''Hao'bai:''' I hope the report I just submitted to Yirou isn't too blunt. I wouldn't want her to feel bad after reading it...
:{{DIcon}} What's going on?
:'''Hao'bai:''' She and I disagree about the restoration of the Sentinel statue.
:'''Hao'bai:''' She's optimistic and idealistic. I admire her determination in launching the project.
:'''Hao'bai:''' It's not that kind of like. Don't get me wrong!
:{{DIcon}} It's too obvious, too!
:{{DIcon}} ...Fine.
:'''Hao'bai:''' ...Ahem, back to the point.
:'''Hao'bai:''' Repairing the statue may not be our top priority, considering we have more urgent issues to address, like upgrading our border defenses.
:'''Hao'bai:''' Well... how can I politely persuade her?
{{Dialogue End}}
